title: Archon War: Eternal Conflict
synopsis: In the world of Teyvat, the Archon War was a cataclysmic event that shaped the destiny of the seven nations. The war was fought between the gods, known as Archons, and their mortal followers. The series explores the complexities of the war and its lasting impact on the world of Teyvat. The story delves into the motivations and actions of key figures, revealing the intricacies of the conflict and its far-reaching consequences.
